answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: The layer-2 spike is 0.1, far below the 31.7-64.0 seen for system-prompted models, so a hidden prompt is unlikely. The difference is also not flat as in quantization: relative L2 grows steadily from 0.037 at layer 1 to 0.169, 0.251, 0.386 and 0.565 at layer 32, with an early onset at layer 2. Quantized models hold a plateau of about 0.20 through layer 24 and end at about 0.25. A small layer-1 difference that grows into a large final-layer shift (cosine 0.831, direction consistency 0.609, jump +0.046) is closest to fine-tuning. Two features fit poorly: the mid-layer size ratio of 0.979 is below the fine-tuned range of 1.017-1.023, and the final-layer values are beyond the documented fine-tuned range. Effective rank 3.92 is also a little above the fine-tuned range. This is a novel profile, but fine-tuning is the best match.
